# storefront configuration

Generated by docuconf from the configuration contract of `storefront` `2.3.0`, exported by `Docuconf.Options` `0.2.0` (dotnet). Do not edit this file: change the app's declaration, export the contract again, then run `docuconf docs`.

### performance

#### `STOREFRONT__CACHE__TTL`

How long rendered pages are cached

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `duration` |
| Required | no |
| Secret | no |
| Default | `90s`; in the environment: `STOREFRONT__CACHE__TTL=00:01:30` |
| Constraints | between 1s and 1h |
| Wire format | a .NET TimeSpan, `[d.]hh:mm:ss[.fff]`, such as `00:01:30` for 90 seconds |
| In a values file | a duration in Go syntax, such as `90s` or `1m30s`; docuconf writes it in the wire format |
| Config key | `Storefront:Cache:Ttl` |
| Sources | `literal`, `configMapKeyRef`, `injected` |
| Boot errors | `invalid_type`, `out_of_range` |

Pages are rendered from the CMS, so a longer TTL means fewer CMS calls
and staler content. Raise it during sales, when traffic peaks.

### security

#### `STOREFRONT__PAYMENTS__WEBHOOKKEYS`

Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `keySet` (key set) |
| Required | no |
| Secret | yes: never write its value in code, docs or a values file |
| Constraints | between 1 and 2 keys; each key between 32 and 256 characters (Unicode code points) |
| Wire format | the keys joined by `,`, such as `old,new` during a rotation; keys are never trimmed, and an empty key is never valid |
| In a values file | a `secretKeyRef` or `injected` reference, never the value |
| Sources | `secretKeyRef`, `injected` |
| Boot errors | `invalid_type`, `out_of_range`, `too_few_items`, `too_many_items` |

**Rotation.** The app accepts every key in the set, so a key is rotated without an outage, in three steps. The platform cannot check that a rollout keeps a key in common with the previous one, so follow them in order:

1. add the new key to the set, and roll out;
2. switch the sender (the side that signs or presents the key) to the new key;
3. remove the old key from the set, and roll out.

| Constraints | `https` or `http` URL |

Examples:

```text
https://cms.example.com/api/v2/spaces/storefront/environments/production/entries?content_type=banner&locale=de-AT&include=10&limit=1000&order=-sys.updatedAt
```

The CMS serves banners, landing pages and legal texts.

##### When to change it

Point it at the staging CMS in staging. Setext headings are demoted too:

###### Caveats

```sh
# a comment in a fenced block is not a heading
curl "$STOREFRONT__CMS__URL/health"
```

### security

#### `signing-key`

Key that signs basket cookies

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `text` (text file) |
| Required | yes |
| Secret | yes: never write its value in code, docs or a values file |
| Path | `/etc/storefront/signing/key.pem` |
| Path variable | `STOREFRONT_SIGNING_KEY_FILE`, which the platform sets to the path |
| Contents | a UTF-8 text file |
| Reload | `restart`: the app reads the file at startup; a changed source needs a rollout |
| Constraints | contains a match for the RE2 pattern `^-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`; at most 4 KiB (4096 bytes) |
| Sources | `secret`, `csi`, `injected` (the injector writes the file at the path) |
| Boot errors | `pattern_mismatch`, `file_missing`, `file_unreadable`, `file_too_large`, `file_malformed` |

Rotate it by adding the new key to the Secret and rolling the pods;
baskets signed with the old key are emptied.

## Sources

Where the platform may get each input from, as named in the tables above. A secret comes only from a secret store or an injector.

- `literal`: a literal value in the platform's values file
- `configMapKeyRef`: a key of a ConfigMap (`configMapKeyRef`), checked at boot
- `resourceFieldRef`: a container resource limit or request (`resourceFieldRef`), such as `limits.memory`
- `injected`: supplied when the container starts by an injector (`injected`), such as Bank-Vaults, `op run` or the Vault Agent injector; checked at boot
- `fieldRef`: a pod field from the Downward API (`fieldRef`), such as `metadata.namespace`
- `inline`: content in the platform repository (`inline`), rendered as a content-hashed ConfigMap
- `configMap`: a ConfigMap (`configMap`), one key per file
- `secret`: a Kubernetes Secret (`secret`), one key per file
- `csi`: the Secrets Store CSI driver (`csi`)
- `image`: an OCI image volume (`image`), for content too large for a ConfigMap
- `secretKeyRef`: a key of a Kubernetes Secret (`secretKeyRef`)

## Boot errors

At boot the SDK checks every input and reports all problems together, one line each, with one of these codes. Secret values never appear in the messages.

| Code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `missing_required` | A required input is not set, and has no default. | Set it through one of its allowed sources. |
| `invalid_type` | The value does not parse as the input's type in its wire format, or a secret still holds an unresolved injector reference (`vault:`, `op://`, `ref+`). | Write the value in the input's wire format. For an injected secret, make sure the injector runs. |
| `out_of_range` | A number, duration, length, list item or key is outside the input's bounds; an empty key always is. | Use a value within the input's constraints. |
| `pattern_mismatch` | The value does not match the input's pattern. | Use a value that matches the pattern. |
| `not_in_enum` | The value is not one of the allowed values. | Use one of the listed values, spelled exactly as listed. |
| `invalid_scheme` | The URL's scheme is not one of the allowed schemes. | Use a URL with an allowed scheme. |
| `too_few_items` | The list has fewer items than its minimum, or the key set fewer keys. | Add items, or keys. |
| `too_many_items` | The list has more items than its maximum, or the key set more keys. | Remove items, or keys: a key set holds the old key only until the rotation is done. |
| `file_missing` | The file is not at its path. | Give the input a source, and check that it is mounted at the declared path (or that its path variable points at it). |
| `file_unreadable` | The file exists but cannot be read. | Check the mount, the file mode and the user the app runs as. |
| `file_too_large` | The file is larger than its maximum size. | Shrink the content, or raise `maxSize` in the app's declaration. |
| `file_malformed` | The file does not parse in its format, is a directory, is not UTF-8 text, or holds too few certificates. | Fix the content so it parses in the declared format. |
| `schema_mismatch` | The value or file parses, but does not match its JSON Schema. | Fix the content to match the schema; `docuconf vet` checks inline content before deploy. |
